content:
Great work on this contribution! The problem statement is clear and engaging, and the idea of detecting alien spaceships through radar signal increases is fun and easy to understand. The input and output formats are well structured, and the example helps illustrate the expected behavior of the algorithm .

Meanwhile, I agree with @5D1NL to the changes

Keep it up—this is a promising and enjoyable contribution!

Formatting
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly as described in the points below.

Goal
* "the signal strictly increases for at least 3 consecutive steps": The wording is inconsistent with your solution, which detects EVERY length-3 increasing sequence, instead of increasing sequences of length at least 3.

* Please replace "ONLY when the signal strictly increases for at least 3 consecutive steps" with "whenever 3 consecutive signal strengths form a strictly increasing sequence. The sequences may overlap".

Input
* Please format "Line 1" and "Line 2" in <<bold>>.

* Please format "N" as a [[variable]] (twice).

Output
* Please replace "(A < B < C)" with "is found".

Constraints
* Please format "N" as a [[variable]].

Cases
* Each test and its validator should cover the same scenario with similar inputs and outputs. Therefore, please revise the cases as follows:

  • Test 1: Add an increasing sequence of length 2 at the end.

  • Test 2: Use strictly decreasing signal strengths only.

  • Validator 3: Insert 9 between 13 and 14.

  • Test 4: Revise the input to follow a similar pattern to that in Validator 4.

* Please add Test 5 and Validator 5 where N = 3 and the sequence is strictly increasing. Avoid using arithmetic sequences as the signal strengths.

* Please add Test 6 and Validator 6 where N = 11 and the sequence is strictly increasing. Avoid using arithmetic sequences as the signal strengths.

* Please add Test 7 and Validator 7 where 11 < N < 20 and the sequence contains increasing, decreasing and unchanged consecutive values, with runs of varying lengths. All signal strengths should be greater than 30 and appear as random as possible.

* Please add Test 8 and Validator 8 where N = 20 and the sequence contains increasing, decreasing and unchanged consecutive values, with runs of varying lengths. The full range 0 to 100 should be used as much as possible, with values appearing as random as possible.

Thanks.
